verdict.rationale: Logseq offers some automation hooks. The docs describe a local HTTP APIs server for external access to the graph, enabled in Features, and a logseq:// protocol whose quick-capture links can be opened from a command-line shell. Both appear to depend on the desktop app running, and nothing shows a true headless mode or CI usage. Missing for 10: a documented headless/CLI runtime that works without the GUI, CI usage examples or guides, and independent corroboration of unattended automation.
